1.visual_beat: Varek hands ONE straight silver spare lightsaber hilt, blade OFF, to Neris by fixed bench; Soren watches from near floor. Neris belt EMPTY, Soren own silver hilt OFF on maroon sash, Varek curved dark hilt OFF at grey sash.
1.narration: Your master puts a lightsaber into a stranger's hands and tells her to take your place.

2.visual_beat: Neris examines the single received silver hilt in BOTH white mitten hands, blade OFF; Soren watches at side, Varek by same fixed chair. No second Neris belt hilt.
2.narration: Neris stands across the stone chamber, turning the hilt over in her hand. You recognise the weapon.

3.visual_beat: Varek settles into fixed chair LEFT of sole sliding door as its motor starts; Soren stands by bench with tool case, Neris holds silver spare blade OFF. Same rack/bench/door geometry.
3.narration: You repaired its switch for Lord Varek, who is now sitting beside the only door.

4.visual_beat: Neris takes one cautious combat stance facing Soren, holding ONE straight silver spare lightsaber with red blade active; Varek watches from fixed chair. Soren own weapon held, no duplicate on belt.
4.narration: You thought learning his secrets would make you harder to replace. But he has brought someone here to see whether you deserve to keep them.

5.visual_beat: Soren glances toward the FIXED dark latch housing on LEFT jamb of the only RIGHT sliding door while holding his single red blade low; Neris in front, Varek seated. No doorway reversal.
5.narration: Before she ignites the blade, you notice the repair you left beneath its grip.

6.visual_beat: Early mechanic Soren crouches beside SAME right freighter ramp hinge, plain charcoal work tunic, NO hood/robe/maroon sash/weapon; one white hand on loose black connector.
6.narration: The switch is the same sort you once had to fix with a loading ramp hanging above you.

7.visual_beat: Mechanic Soren examines frayed connector under SAME ramp hinge; disconnected brake assembly lies on fixed foreground-left bench. Grey freighter at right, no changed ship side.
7.narration: Back then, your name is Soren, and you work in a repair dock where nobody waits for a mechanic to finish eating.

8.visual_beat: Mechanic Soren removes ONE loose connector under raised right ramp while anonymous white-round-headed pilot leans from upper opening toward controls. No added main cast.
8.narration: A freighter needs its ramp before the next berth opens. You are underneath it, holding a loose connector while the pilot shouts from the cockpit.

9.visual_beat: Pilot reaches control at SAME upper right ramp doorway; ramp begins lowering toward mechanic Soren's shoulder. Retain hinge, cable and fore-left workbench.
9.narration: You ask her to keep the controls still. She reaches for them anyway, and the ramp begins coming down.

10.visual_beat: Soren raises ONE empty white palm just under SAME lowering ramp, a clear air gap between hand and metal; other hand holds removed connector. Ramp suspended by invisible Force, no physical prop.
10.narration: Your hand goes up before you can move. The ramp stops with its weight hanging above your shoulder.

11.visual_beat: Crop to the clear gap between Soren's raised pure-white mitten palm and SAME ramp underside, connector in other hand. No realistic human fingers or touching metal.
11.narration: You stare at the gap between your palm and the metal. Nothing is touching.

12.visual_beat: Soren scrambles left toward intact dock floor carrying connector while pilot cuts ramp power; SAME freighter/ramp stops. Mechanics clothes remain plain charcoal/black.
12.narration: The pilot cuts the power, and you scramble out with the connector still in your other hand.

13.visual_beat: Soren looks down at ONE disconnected brake assembly on fixed left bench, connector held beside it; no active weapon or robe.
13.narration: You tell yourself the emergency brake must have caught. Then you notice the brake assembly sitting on your bench.

14.visual_beat: Lysa in olive jacket/tan trousers stands beside workbench questioning Soren about the held ramp; SAME grey freighter right, no new repair bay.
14.narration: Lysa, the courier waiting for that freighter, has seen everything. She asks how you held it.

15.visual_beat: Soren points at disconnected brake controls on fixed left bench while Lysa questions him; two compact white-round-headed adults once each.
15.narration: You point at the disconnected controls. She looks at them, then asks again.

16.visual_beat: Varek in charcoal robes/grey mantle walks from clear dock path toward Soren and Lysa beside SAME right freighter ramp. No extra Varek in ship window.
16.narration: Before you answer, a passenger in black robes walks down the dock.

17.visual_beat: Varek indicates the connector in Soren's white mitten hand near SAME bench/ramp; Soren looks up, Lysa only. Varek's weapon remains OFF.
17.narration: He was close enough to see your raised hand. His name is Varek, and he asks you to bring the connector with you.

18.visual_beat: Varek closes SAME north cargo hatch behind himself while Soren stands by ONE green central crate; ONE small U-shaped grey clip rests on crate. No active lightsaber.
18.narration: He takes you into an empty cargo hold and closes the hatch. A loose metal clip rests on a crate between you.

19.visual_beat: Varek points to the small U-shaped clip on central crate and Soren raises a cautious empty palm towards it; same right raised loading platform, north hatch CLOSED.
19.narration: He asks you to lift it without touching it. You spend several uncomfortable minutes staring at a piece of scrap.

20.visual_beat: Varek slides SAME green crate a little toward the fixed RIGHT loading-platform edge; Soren reaches toward the small clip. Not a cliff or open floor hole.
20.narration: When he slides the crate toward the edge of a loading platform, you reach for the clip.

21.visual_beat: ONE tiny U-shaped metal clip jumps a short distance from same green crate toward Soren's open white mitten palm; Varek watches. No cylinder/hilt substitution.
21.narration:
It jumps against your palm before your fingers close.

Varek asks what you felt beneath the ramp.

22.visual_beat: Varek puts SAME small U-shaped clip back on central green crate while Soren steadies his raised hand; closed north hatch and right platform unchanged.
22.narration: You tell him you thought it was going to crush you. He places the clip on the crate again. This time, you know something is possible.

23.visual_beat: Soren lifts the same tiny U-shaped clip a few centimetres above central crate; Varek's hand stays away. One clip, no glow orb or giant tool.
23.narration: You can move it a short distance when you remember the ramp falling. When your attention slips, the clip drops.

24.visual_beat: Varek picks up same dropped tiny clip from crate and holds it between white mittens while Soren listens; no new bench or door.
24.narration:
Varek picks it up and tells you he can teach you to do more.

You ask what the teaching costs.

25.visual_beat: Varek explains his offer with one open empty hand while Soren stands beside green crate considering it; keep bare cargo hold and closed north hatch.
25.narration: He wants an apprentice who will travel with him, follow instructions and keep what he learns to himself.

26.visual_beat: Soren packs ONE small old dark rectangular tool case on fixed left bench; Lysa beside him questions his departure. Same mechanic work tunic and freighter ramp right.
26.narration: You have no place on his ship unless you take the offer. Lysa catches you putting your tools into a small case.

27.visual_beat: Soren carries closed old tool case toward the same freighter ramp while Lysa pauses beside bench.
27.narration: She asks whether you even know where you're going. You tell her that you will finally be able to choose something beyond the next broken ramp.

28.visual_beat: Varek settles the new MAROON sash on Soren's charcoal apprentice robe beside fixed RIGHT bunk. Old tool case sits in under-bunk recess. Soren no personal weapon yet.
28.narration: Varek gives you a charcoal tunic and a maroon sash. Your tools stay in their case beneath the bunk.

29.visual_beat: ONE squat grey Varek ship stands landed on SAME upper stone pad; Soren and Varek beside lowered ramp look at low rectangular residence and dry valley RIGHT. No descending ship with same actors on ground twice.
29.narration: His ship carries you to a remote stone residence above a dry valley.

30.visual_beat: Soren enters the ONE fixed plain training chamber and observes left rod rack, back bench, chair and single right sliding door. No weapon yet, square floor, no banners/targets.
30.narration: The training room is almost empty: a rack, a floor marked by old impacts and a heavy door that closes slowly enough to make you watch it.

31.visual_beat: Soren raises a questioning hand to Varek beside same fixed bench; sole door remains RIGHT and chair next to it. Two actors only, no imaginary additional students.
31.narration: You ask whether other students are coming. Varek says that he already has an apprentice.

32.visual_beat: Varek points from himself to Soren, explaining one master/one apprentice; both in same open floor before fixed bench. No inserted ancient Sith actor.
32.narration: He follows the Sith tradition of one master and one apprentice.

33.visual_beat: Varek sets TWO plain wooden training rods apart on fixed bench while explaining the rule's origin; Soren watches. No new historic hall, hologram or Bane portrait.
33.narration: Darth Bane established that rule to end the fighting that had weakened the Sith.

34.visual_beat: Varek walks a single step on far side of Soren across same square-slab floor, speaking; show one instant, no multiple Varek silhouettes.
34.narration: Varek describes the apprentice's purpose while he walks around you.

35.visual_beat: Soren looks from Varek's grey mantle toward the two plain rods on fixed bench; master explains future challenge. No own silver hilt yet.
35.narration: You will learn what he knows, become strong enough to challenge him and eventually take his place.

36.visual_beat: Soren holds trembling white mitten hands above ONE tiny grey U-shaped practice clip on same back bench; Varek observes at chair side.
36.narration:
He says this without looking worried. You are still trying to lift a clip.

The first lessons leave your hands shaking.

37.visual_beat: Soren levitates ONE small grey stone practice block above square floor beside fixed bench, hands raised; Varek speaks from a few paces away. No temple platform.
37.narration: You raise objects, hold them steady and lose them whenever Varek interrupts you.

38.visual_beat: Varek asks Soren a question while SAME small stone block hovers above fixed central floor; Soren hesitates with hands lifted, single block.
38.narration: He asks questions while a stone block is suspended above the floor. If you answer too quickly, the block drops.

39.visual_beat: Varek sweeps Soren's near boot with one foot; Soren leans off balance while SAME practice block stays above floor. ONE body/pose each, two arms only.
39.narration: If you keep staring at it, he knocks your feet out from beneath you. You have to recover your balance while keeping the thing in the air.

40.visual_beat: Soren regains his grounded stance and keeps SAME stone practice block floating while looking toward Varek's moving boot. Square floor and door axis fixed.
40.narration: You improve when you stop waiting for each interruption. You begin listening to his movement as well as watching the stone.

41.visual_beat: Soren turns his WHITE round head toward Varek's foot before it reaches him; SAME stone block remains suspended. No extra limbs or copied pose.
41.narration: On one attempt, you turn before his foot reaches you. The block remains suspended.

42.visual_beat: Varek opens SAME RIGHT sliding stone door toward its RIGHT pocket while Soren continues holding block above floor. Left rack/bench/chair remain fixed.
42.narration: Varek leaves it there while he opens the door. You cannot follow until he lets you put it down.

43.visual_beat: Varek hands Soren ONE plain brown wooden training rod at fixed bench, practice block now FULLY on floor. No red blade or finished lightsaber.
43.narration:
Even a successful lesson ends when he decides it does.

He teaches you to fight with a training weapon before giving you a real blade.

44.visual_beat: Varek catches Soren's white wrist as ONE brown practice rod drops near same left rack; one instantaneous movement, no sword glow.
44.narration: The first time you rush him, he catches your wrist and sends the weapon across the room. You fetch it.

45.visual_beat: Soren attacks with ONE plain brown training rod while Varek guards with a second brown rod; SAME open central floor, no active lightsabers at this stage.
45.narration: He tells you to use the frustration you are already feeling. On the next exchange, you push harder.

46.visual_beat: Varek steps beside Soren's brown practice rod strike, drawing him past fixed bench; Soren still grips ONE wooden rod, no empty-handed punch or red weapon.
46.narration:
He steps aside and makes you chase him into the same mistake.

Eventually you make him change position.

47.visual_beat: ONE square loose floor slab shifts a little under Varek's boot while he blocks Soren's brown wooden rod; both rods are WOOD, no red blades.
47.narration: A loose floor plate shifts beneath his boot when you reach through the Force. He stops your next strike, but you have made him move.

48.visual_beat: Varek points toward SAME right door's left-jamb mechanism while Soren lowers wooden practice rod; displaced floor plate remains beside his boot.
48.narration: You expect him to mention the plate. Instead, he asks you to repair the door mechanism after training.

49.visual_beat: Soren crouches repairing SAME left-jamb dark latch housing on RIGHT sliding door with old tool case open below; rod returned to fixed left rack, no own saber yet.
49.narration: It has been catching at the end of its travel. You spend the evening with the housing open, learning how much stone the motor is supposed to move.

50.visual_beat: Soren with closed old tool case walks among plain cargo stacks at same low transfer-port courier berth; small grey courier craft not the fixed red freighter.
50.narration: Your first mission takes you back among cargo ships. Varek wants a sealed navigation archive delivered to him.

51.visual_beat: Soren watches anonymous adult cargo workers move ONE green-grey archive crate up fixed RED ordinary freighter ramp on RIGHT; courier berth/counter separate.
51.narration: Its current holder is preparing to leave through a busy transfer port.

52.visual_beat: Varek gives Soren ONE small dark physical transmitter beside fixed back-left counter, not a floating hologram; Soren looks toward port berth, no own saber yet.
52.narration: He sends you to arrange transport before the shipment moves. You expect him to come with you.

53.visual_beat: Soren holds the transmitter while Lysa in olive jacket/tan pants works behind same plain back-left payment counter; no new office scene.
53.narration:
He gives you a transmitter and tells you to report when you have the archive.

Lysa is working at the port.

54.visual_beat: Lysa points at Soren's SAME old dark tool case resting beside counter, a wry tiny line-mouth reaction. Soren apprentice robe/maroon sash, no weapon.
54.narration: She recognises the tool case you still carry and asks whether your new employer has broken something already.

55.visual_beat: Soren shows ONE simple unlabelled destination sketch and two small plain payment tokens on SAME counter; Lysa checks them before agreeing.
55.narration: You tell her that you need a pilot who can make a difficult collection. She asks for the destination and payment before agreeing.

56.visual_beat: Soren passes ONE payment token to Lysa beside counter, she gestures toward his apprentice robe; same fixed red freighter stays context, no ship duplicates.
56.narration: You give her both. She points at your robes and asks whether the passenger will be as quiet as the cargo.

57.visual_beat: Soren places his old tool case beside same fixed LEFT cabin crate stack and looks at transmitter. Single centre aft hatch CLOSED during flight, monitor/table RIGHT. Lysa checks a navigation token at fixed right worktable, not in a second cabin.
57.narration: You board her small courier ship with the instructions Varek supplied.

58.visual_beat: Soren stands at fixed centred transfer-vessel hatch with transmitter, Lysa waiting near LEFT corridor rail. One anonymous adult guard visible inside refuses access.
58.narration: Lysa can get you near the transfer vessel, but its crew refuses to hand over the archive. You send Varek a message.

59.visual_beat: Soren listens to Varek ONCE ONLY on fixed RIGHT physical cabin monitor, transmitter in hand; no physical full-body Varek or hologram. Centre aft hatch closed.
59.narration: He tells you that an apprentice should not need his master to settle a disagreement with a cargo crew.

60.visual_beat: Soren raises an empty demanding palm toward ONE guard inside SAME centred hatch; Lysa at left rail, Soren has NO personal saber yet.
60.narration:
You return to the loading hatch and demand that they open it.
